eps.ov: "Sortie! Sunred" The hero of justice, Astro Fighter Sunred, heads to a nearby beef bowl restaurant to get lunch. As he leaves the restaurant with his takeout bento box in hand, Sunred is interrupted by monsters from the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim, led by General Vamp...!!

"Explosive!? Twin Death Attack" Khamenman and Medaleo, the monsters of Florsheim who usually playfully bicker with each other, are having a heated argument in the kitchen of their hideout today. What could be the reason...?

"Usacots, the Terrifying Secret" The town of Mizonokuchi continues to enjoy its peaceful days. A single shadow streaks across the cloudless sky—Usacots, the terrifying monster of Florsheim. What is clutched in his hand...?

"Danger!! An assassin from China!?" A mysterious figure stands alone in an apartment in Mizonokuchi, Takatsu Ward, Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture. This man is none other than a fearsome assassin from China, who has crossed the vast ocean and landed in this land with the aim of world domination...!!

"Florsheim's Fundraising Operation!!" To fulfill their ambition of world domination and defeat their arch-enemy Sunred, even evil organizations need operating funds. In order to raise funds for their branch, where did the three monsters, Khamenman, Medaleo, and Usacots, go in the scorching heat of summer...?

To eliminate his arch-nemesis, Sunred, the "drinking devil," the Kawasaki branch of Florsheim has welcomed a new monster: Nisica, an emissary from the Inca Empire. Soon after arriving in Kawasaki from the distant Inca Empire, where does he go to prepare for his battle with Sunred...?

"A mystery!! Is the orca a fish that changes its name as it grows!?" General Vamp and the members of the Florsheim Kawasaki branch are summoned by Sunred, a rare occurrence. In the scorching heat, with a photochemical smog warning issued, what is the matter that Red brings up...?

"The Demon Arrives via Cool Delivery!" To defeat Sunred, the Astro Fighter and nemesis who stands in the way of world domination, a new monster, Dels, has been sent to the Kawasaki branch of Florsheim. Still not in his complete form, he arrived via cool delivery...!?
"The terrifying army is on the move!" A sinister shadow lurks in a certain mountainous area of ​​Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture. A truly terrifying army of evil is attacking Red!!

In "Vamp's Mission Impossible," General Vamp of the Florsheim Kawasaki branch finally gets his hands on a cell phone. The first person he calls is Sunred's girlfriend, Kayoko. Intrigued by the information he receives from her, Vamp heads to Kayoko's house where Sunred lives...

"Sunred dies in the sand!?" At a certain family restaurant in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture, the villains of the evil organization Florsheim have gathered, plotting a new plan to eliminate the hero of justice, Astro Fighter Sunred!!

"The Florsheim Monster Army: A Terrifying Ambition" Gamess, a monster from Florsheim, is spending his days peacefully in a cheap apartment. What is the news of the sudden visitor that shatters his tranquility...?

"A strange phenomenon in the attic! Red has nowhere to run!?" It's a drizzly day in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture. Kayoko is cleaning on her day off, but she gets into a fight with Red, who's just lounging around and not helping. Where will Red go after storming out of Kayoko's apartment...?

"A New Terror in Kawasaki" Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture, continues to enjoy its peaceful days. But in this land that is not the capital, a new shadow is creeping in... What fate awaits the members of the Florsheim Kawasaki branch, who are rooted in the community and plotting world domination? And what will become of our hero, Sunred?!

"Red's past is now revealed!" The first train of the day on the Nambu Line speeds through the dawn. Inside the train, two monsters from the Froshheim Kawasaki branch, Reets and Takker, are talking when a blue shadow suddenly speaks to them. Who is this...?
"Ant Killer: A Death Sentence!" A seemingly peaceful family restaurant in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture, on a lazy afternoon. But a dark shadow looms over the smoking section...!

"Fish meat!? The mystery of Florsheim sausage!" A package suddenly arrives at the home of Kayoko, the hero of Kawasaki City, Astro Fighter Sunred. The sender is Sunred's arch-enemy, the evil organization Florsheim, which plots world domination!

"Florsheim's Hellish Obon Holiday" Obon—it is a traditional event that has been passed down in Japan since ancient times. During this period, people return to the homes where they were born and raised, to welcome the spirits of their ancestors and to heal from the fatigue of their daily lives. And, needless to say, the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim also took a well-deserved break!

"Sunred Elimination Meeting" The evil organization Florsheim, which plots world domination, is once again formulating a plan to eliminate its arch-enemy, Astro Fighter Sunred, at its Kawasaki branch!!
"Vamp, building a killer robot!?" Red is waiting for Kayoko to come home from her house. Suddenly, the doorbell rings! Thinking it's Kayoko, Red opens the door, but what he sees there is...!
"Vamp's Shield" Today, Vamp once again faces off against Sunred in Kawasaki. But before the showdown, Red says something to him...!

"Weather Three's Heroic Actions" Four figures race through a residential area in the afternoon. They are the fleeing monsters of Florsheim and the messengers of justice pursuing them, Weather Red and Weather Blue of the Weather Three weather squadron!

An article about the Florsheim monsters dances across the newspaper that Kayoko, the "Red Hostage," is reading. Has their plot for world domination finally progressed to the point where it's making headlines in the newspapers...?

"Florsheim vs. Sunred: A Bone-Chilling Battle" One evening at the Florsheim Kawasaki branch, General Vamp, who plots world domination, is busy working in the kitchen when he finds slices of Matsusaka beef! "As someone aiming for world domination, I need to know what the real thing tastes like!" he says, and the monsters are moved by his words, but what nightmare befalls them...?

"The Man Waiting in Front of Musashi-Mizonokuchi Station" The members of the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim, which plots world domination, were engrossed in frying sata andagi (Okinawan doughnuts) in the kitchen of their hideout. Suddenly, the phone rang! The caller was none other than Astro Fighter Sunred. And Red's request was…

"Love and romance are just... that!" Burning earth, raging air. Forgetting all the previous silliness, Florsheim finally bares its terrifying fangs, and the final battle between it and the hero of justice, Sunred, begins now! For what they believe in, for what they love, these men fight!!
